subject: Rick Caraviello Candidate Profile
overview: Candidate Rick Caraviello presented his platform for the Medford City Council election, focusing on rezoning opposition, school funding, and infrastructure.

items.title: Rick Caraviello Candidate Statement
items.summary: Rick Caraviello outlined his platform for Medford City Council, emphasizing his opposition to the proposed citywide rezoning plan, his advocacy for a new high school, and his support for fully staffing and funding the police and public works departments.
